name: bespunky-angular
description: BeSpunky's Angular adapter skills — an optional plugin a project wears when it wears Angular (the scaffolder enables it for projects with the angular layer). angular-architecture: modern-Angular technique clusters (standalone, signals, inject(), provideX) with progressive-disclosure references — DI and providers, lifecycle and reactivity, SSR/zone/change detection, extensibility and plugins, content projection and DOM bridging, component API ergonomics. angular-native-wrappers: wrap an imperative or third-party JS API (maps, editors, charts, players, canvas/WebGL, native browser APIs) in idiomatic, type-safe Angular without a hand-written pass-through per native call. The stack-agnostic mindset and design toolbox they realize live in bespunky-engineering.
